type.description: The type of target, indicating the communication protocol.

settings.description: Configuration settings specific to the target type.

EmailSettings.title: Email Settings
EmailSettings.description: Used to send notifications or alerts to a specified recipient via email.

name.description: The display name of the recipient.

MaxBufferCount.description: Maximum number of events that can be buffered before delivery.

WebhookSettings.title: Webhook Settings
WebhookSettings.description: Configuration for webhook-based targets. Includes the HTTP method, destination URL, and a secret used for signing and validating webhook messages.

destination.description: The destination URL where webhook events will be sent.

method.description: HTTP method used to deliver webhook events.

secret.description: Secret key used to sign webhook payloads. Must be at least 10 characters long.

WebsocketSettings.title: WebSocket Settings
WebsocketSettings.description: Configuration for WebSocket-based targets. Used to establish a connection and authenticate event delivery.

secret.description: Secret used to authenticate the WebSocket connection. Must be at least 10 characters long.
